map.「矿山安全规程/检查/培训体系合规评估，对照《煤矿安全规程》从五个维度评分并判定: The compliance assessment of the mine safety regulation / inspection / training system scores five dimensions against the Coal Mine Safety Regulations from the input parameters and outputs the result.
map.矿山安全规程/检查/培训体系合规评估工具，对照《煤矿安全规程》从瓦斯浓度、通风、: A compliance assessment tool for mine safety regulations / inspection / training systems, scoring and judging the safety level across five dimensions — gas concentration, ventilation, equipment, training and hazard rectification — against the Coal Mine Safety Regulations.
map.📚 深度解析：安全（规程/检查/培训）体系评估: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Safety (Regulations / Inspection / Training) System Assessment
map.矿山安全生产标准化自评：逐项录入瓦斯、通风、设备、培训、整改、监测等实测值，自动: Self-assessment for work safety standardisation: enter measured gas, ventilation, equipment, training, rectification and monitoring values item by item to get the number of compliant items and the grade automatically.
map.迎检准备：对照标准化评分表核查各门槛（如通风量比≥1.0、设备完好率≥95%），: Inspection preparation: check each threshold against the standardisation score sheet (such as airflow ratio ≥1.0, equipment intact rate ≥95%) to locate non-compliant items.
map.整改跟踪：记录隐患整改率与监测覆盖率，观察等级是否从基本达标提升到标准化。: Rectification tracking: record the hazard rectification rate and monitoring coverage and observe whether the grade rises from basically compliant to standardised.
map.六项检查：①瓦斯浓度≤1.0% 达标；②通风量比=实测/要求≥1.0 达标；③设: Six checks: ①gas concentration ≤1.0% compliant; ②airflow ratio=measured/required ≥1.0 compliant; ③equipment intact rate ≥95% compliant; ④training pass rate ≥90% and training hours ≥24h compliant; ⑤hazard rectification rate ≥90% compliant; ⑥monitoring coverage ≥95% compliant. 6 compliant items = level 1, ≥5 level 2, ≥4 level 3, ≥3 basically compliant, <3 non-compliant requiring production suspension.
map.瓦斯 0.6%、通风实测 8000/要求 7500（比 1.067）、设备完好: Gas 0.6%, ventilation measured 8000 / required 7500 (ratio 1.067), equipment intact 96%, training pass 95% with 28h hours, rectification rate 92%, monitoring coverage 98%. All six compliant, airflow ratio 1.067≥1.0, judged "work safety standardisation (level 1)".
map.培训合格 95% 但学时仅 20h，因 20<24 判不达标，整体降为二级；瓦斯: Training pass 95% but only 20 hours; since 20<24 it is judged non-compliant and the overall drops to level 2. Gas 1.0% is exactly compliant (≤1.0) while 1.01% is not. Threshold values use closed intervals (≤/≥), so leave safety margin when entering data.
map.标准化一级到不达标的分级依据？: What is the basis for grading from standardisation level 1 to non-compliant?
map.依据金属非金属矿山安全生产标准化规范思路，按关键安全门槛的达标项数分级：全部达标: It follows the thinking of the metal and non-metal mine work safety standardisation specification, grading by the number of compliant key safety thresholds: all compliant is level 1, missing 1 item level 2, missing 2 items level 3, missing 3 items basically compliant, and missing 4 or more is non-compliant requiring suspension and rectification. This tool uses a simplified six-item threshold; an actual review has more items, so follow the current score sheet.
map.为什么培训要看学时和合格率两项？: Why does training look at both hours and pass rate?
map.合格率是结果、学时是过程。只合格率达标但学时不足（如突击补训），知识与应急能力未: The pass rate is the outcome, the hours are the process. A good pass rate with insufficient hours (such as crammed make-up training) does not guarantee solid knowledge and emergency response; both conditions (pass ≥90% and hours ≥24h) must hold for training to be compliant, which avoids padding the numbers with certificates.
map.瓦斯浓度依据《煤矿安全规程》回风流CH₄≤1%: Gas concentration follows the Coal Mine Safety Regulations: return airway CH₄ ≤1%
map.通风量满足矿井需风量要求，严禁超通风能力生产: Airflow must meet the mine required airflow; production beyond ventilation capacity is strictly forbidden
map.全员安全培训每年不少于24学时，新工人不少于72学时: All-staff safety training at least 24 hours per year, new workers at least 72 hours
map.安全设备完好率应≥95%，监测监控系统全覆盖: Safety equipment intact rate should be ≥95%, with full monitoring and control coverage
map.安全隐患排查实行闭环管理，重大隐患需挂牌督办: Safety hazard investigation follows closed-loop management; major hazards require listed supervision with public notice
